The roster's exact DeepSeek V4 Flash variant is not established as a current subscription route. DeepSeek states the previous-generation V4 Flash was retired and its legacy API name is temporarily routed to V4.1 Flash. OpenCode separately lists V4 Flash and V4.1 Flash with different Go caps ($30 vs $60), but does not document the upstream variant behind its legacy catalog row; Ollama's listed route is V4.1 Flash. The value multiple is unavailable because no current route is evidenced for the exact benchmark variant; no sibling entitlement or tariff is transferred.

claims.claim: The table covers every exact ValueRank roster AA slug, with 25 coverage rows.
OpenCode routes use only exact model display names listed by OpenCode and the matching per-model usage cap and tariff from the same provider page.
Ollama dollar credits have a direct API-equivalent amount under the same route's published token prices; single-model token totals depend on the stated mix.
Z.AI GLM-5.3 subscription credits can be converted only with that exact model's published coefficients and Z.AI's matching API rates; values are profile-dependent.
Z.AI GLM Coding Plan is not used for the GLM-5.2 roster row because its own documentation redirects GLM-5.2 to GLM-5.3.
For the GLM-5.3 roster row, Z.AI Max annual has the largest supported value multiple among the fully quantified exact-route candidates, approximately 9.43×–9.93× across profiles.

The route comparison reports the highest supported route among the quantified candidate set; it is not a universal market census where another provider has an exact model but an opaque subscription denominator.
No numeric user-reported allowance is used as a table denominator; permitted OpenAI/Codex crowdsourced data is limited to the TiboTattle homepage and yielded no usable numeric series.
Temporary Z.AI promotions active on the as-of date are surfaced but excluded from sustainable monthly route ranking.

OpenCode separately lists DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4.1 Flash; its plan caps are not interchanged, and the upstream legacy-alias notice alone does not prove which version OpenCode serves through its legacy catalog entry.

Quarterly Z.AI billing is documented, but a quarterly fee was not publicly displayed in the inspected current page; the quarterly API-equivalent dollar value can be computed, while the monthly value multiple is not computable.

The selected Z.AI GLM-5.3-Flash Max annual route is best only under the 2026-09-25–2026-10-07 half-credit promotion; its standard sustainable baseline is OpenCode Go, and the separate overnight flash campaign is not annualized or stacked.

No exact-version subscription route is selected for the roster's DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 row because the current subscription variant behind legacy catalog/alias routes is not established; V4.1 Flash allowances are not transferred.
